name: auto-effort
description: Picks the reasoning effort for each prompt from a cheap difficulty check, so easy turns run at low effort and hard ones at high.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Pick the effort per prompt in new sessions. /auto-effort on|off overrides it for a session.

efforts.title: Efforts per label
efforts.description: Efforts for trivial,routine,involved,open, in that order (each low, medium, high, xhigh or max).

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Full model id of the model that rates each prompt.

timeoutMs.title: Judge timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long a turn waits for the judge before it runs at the session effort (100-60000).

subagentCap.title: Subagent effort cap
subagentCap.description: off, or a level: subagent requests above it are lowered to it.

logDir.title: Log directory
logDir.description: Where the per-session decision logs go; empty means ~/.claude/auto-effort.
